description: Source code for the MRD (Multicast Routing Daemon) component, managing multicast tables, shared memory, network routes, ARP cache, and ping operations within a network device.

methods.name: mrd_signal_handlr
methods.description: Signal handler for cleanup and exit.

methods.name: mrd_getMACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address for a given IP from ARP cache.

methods.name: mrd_log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to a log file.

methods.name: mrd_hashindex
methods.description: Computes hash index for IP address in white list.

methods.name: mrd_updateMcastlistlifetime
methods.description: Decrements lifetime counters and deletes stale multicast entries.

methods.name: mrd_shmattach
methods.description: Attaches to shared memory for white list.

methods.name: mrd_wlistInit
methods.description: Initializes white list, attaches shared memory, and cleans routes.

methods.name: mrdnode_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a node in the white list by IP.

methods.name: send_pings
methods.description: Sends ping requests to network nodes based on multicast tables.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop managing multicast routing, ARP, and network health.
